name: shepherd
description: Sprint-by-sprint version-cycle conductor. Six-agent flock (engineer, critic, coder, auditor, worker, discovery) on a three-section sprint pipeline (INTRODUCTION → BODY → CLOSE). v5.1.1 adds: @discovery sixth lane (read-only orientation + research synthesis); INTRO-COMBO-WAVE (discoveries + intro-mode auditors fire in parallel before MESH); hypothesis-driven auditor (superpowers:systematic-debugging discipline with per-finding Hypothesis + Falsification + Confidence); sprint-as-patch framing (each dev.N is operator-equivalent to a full patch). v5.1.0 added: flock-cohesion substrate (canonical-types index, sibling-lanes briefs, cross-lane INSIGHTS), dispatch cascade (shctx plan extract + shctx graph next/mark mechanizing the Stage Graph walk), pause-for-dependency primitive. Project-agnostic — branch topology, gates, paths, and ledger discipline configured per-project via .claude/shepherd.toml.
